{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nazzar government''' was the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] government of the world [[Nazzri]]. For [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], it was a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] headed by [[Emperor-King]]s, but eventually it was replaced with an [[Oligarchy|oligarchical]] [[theocracy]] based on the [[Ulizra]] religion.<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
